entities.summary: The Ludwik Zamenhof Centre is a cultural institution located in Białystok, Poland, at ulica Warszawska 19. It was founded at the initiative of the city's president (mayor) in celebration of the 94th World Congress of Esperanto that was held in Białystok from 25 July to 1 August 2009.
